        pieces = []

            a, b, c = map(int, input[ptr:ptr+3])
            ptr += 3
            pieces.append((a, b, c))

        adj = defaultdict(set)
        degree = defaultdict(int)
        for a, b, c in pieces:

            adj[c].add(a)
            adj[c].add(b)
            degree[a] += 2
            degree[b] += 2
            degree[c] += 2

        start = None

            visited.add(current)
            neighbors = list(adj[current])
